m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: AAAH! I'm sorry! I had to take the waterskin! Would you condemn a lonely, broken Boa for simply trying to live? I was thirsty!
What'll you do when you get lonely, and nobody's waiting by your side? You'll go mad! I should return the waterskin, shouldn't I?
AAAH! No! The waterskin doesn't matter! Nothing matters anymore! The world has forsaken me! You want the waterskin? Come take it!
You've got me on my knees! Kill me if you must; just spare me your judgment. I'm already dead inside. Wh-what is this?
Layla's Betrothal Torque! How did you come by it, Wizard? Did you steal it? If you hurt Lay- What? Layla sent you to give it to me?
Oh. Then that means... she loves me. I knew it! Hm. It also means she has not yet been forced to wed her father's crony, General Naja.
A marriage union cannot be official without the exchange of Betrothal items. I must stop this wedding before another Torque can be forged!
But it won't be easy. No doubt Layla will be under heavy guard. They'll be waiting for me. I'll need help. Interested? Great!
We can't just stroll in together through the Serpentine Gate. I'll sneak back in the way I snuck out. Find me in the shadows!
Nothing could keep me from you. Not Naja. Not your father. Not the entire Serpentine Army. Marry me, Layla. I'm begging darling, please.
Wizard! Terrible news! I overheard that the wedding is not only still on, but it's happening today! I just don't know where.
Perhaps details of a wedding between the Kommander's daughter and a General will have trickled down the ranks?
The entire Serpentine Army will be alerted if I'm seen. Could you get the Street Vipers to cough up the location of the wedding?
Did you learn the wedding location? The Officer's Club? Then we must hurry there! Come, friend. We've a wedding to crash!
There you are! Naja has just presented Layla with his Betrothal Dagger! We have to act now. LAAAAY-LAAA!
I'm not mad, Naja. Just in love. And Layla can't give you her Betrothal Torque, because she's already given it to me.
You don't belong here! I hope you realize as Kobra Kommander's daughter, I could summon the entire Serpentine Army in an instant.
But I will overlook your trespass if you agree to do me a favor. Deal? Good. I need someone who can deftly move in and out of Istanboa.
I fear for the wellbeing of my dear friend, Qhays. He was banished from the city after - let's call it an 'unfortunate altercation'.
If I know Qhays, he's run to the place in the Rubal Wastes where he and I would sneak off to as children. We called it our Hideaway.
Qhays is not bad, just... emotional. And his sensitivity is matched only by his brute strength. He always regrets his outbursts.
Knowing Qhays is alone and in pain breaks my heart. I need you to give him this Torque. Please. It will bring him solace. Thank you.
My friend Qhays is alone and hurting, but I think this Torque may give him a bit of solace. Please go to our Hideaway and give it to him.
